title.en: Corrected EM finite spectra and candidates
title.zh: 修正的 EM 有限谱及候选

summary: Compose source EM cases, corrected finite matrices and original-order spectra with bounded numerical evidence.

identity.direction: inverse: angular frequency to finite-model spectrum
identity.definition: All finite matrix eigenvalues are retained. Selected5 are heuristic positive-real, least-|imaginary| candidates; physical-state similarity-scaled backward gate<=2e-12.
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

inputs.name: omegas
inputs.description: Angular frequency axis; None selects the source frequency ladder.
inputs.constraints: Finite real nonzero elements; input order retained.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: kxx[axis length,5] m^-1; all spectra and selection candidates per frequency, matrix, exact tables, source case state and independent eigen diagnostics.
outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described
outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.

preconditions: Pinned Linux amd64 GNU Octave7.3.0 runtime; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
NumPy2.5.3 and SciPy1.18.1 Python3.12 scientific development runtime.
supported: Two cases, J8/J12, all eight N controls and source79-frequency default.
All finite spectra, source-order values, selection candidates and terminal matrices.
excluded: No claim that every auxiliary eigenvalue is a kinetic physical mode; no infinite-mode completeness or cross-thread invariance.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError for unsupported/missing native runtime or abnormal native exit; subprocess timeout is explicit.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result; no failed or partial execution is presented as a successful output.

provenance.lineage_summary: fluidBW upstream79829170 → retained D0 7fd667f4 → faithful D1 1a6704a7 → corrected D2. Source issues, intended divergences and scientific derivations are explained in the corrected full retained increment review narrative.

verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded analytic, independent constitutive, root and state tests in the pinned runtime support the declared numerical model. Neither an all-input-universe accuracy proof nor expert scientific approval.

J/L pole and finite-harmonic approximation errors remain distinct from relation consistency and numerical residual.

execution.mode: ordinary DAG evaluated independently in ordered finite frequency sweep
execution.ordering: case state then constrained poles, scalar matrices then eig-only values, separate vectors/gate then candidate filtering and collect full terminal states
branches: positive-real threshold1e-5kn and five least-|imaginary| candidates
